environmentVariables.name: APP_ENVIRONMENT
environmentVariables.purpose: Authoritative application security-environment identity; never inferred from a host, branch, URL, or request.
environmentVariables.rotation: Change only through reviewed environment rebinding; redeploy required.

environmentVariables.name: SUPABASE_ENVIRONMENT
environmentVariables.purpose: Declares the logical Supabase target class and must match APP_ENVIRONMENT compatibility rules.
environmentVariables.rotation: Change only with an authorized target rebind; redeploy required.

environmentVariables.name: SUPABASE_PROJECT_REF
environmentVariables.purpose: Binds the declared target to the project reference encoded by the public Supabase URL.
environmentVariables.sourceBoundary: Explicit non-secret target metadata; use local for loopback Supabase.
environmentVariables.rotation: Change only with an authorized project rebind; redeploy required.

environmentVariables.name: PREVIEW_SUPABASE_PROJECT_REF
environmentVariables.purpose: Non-secret registry identity for the isolated Preview Supabase project.
environmentVariables.sourceBoundary: Explicit environment-scoped metadata; never populated with a credential.
environmentVariables.rotation: Change only when the Preview Supabase project is separately reauthorized and rebound.

environmentVariables.name: STAGING_SUPABASE_PROJECT_REF
environmentVariables.purpose: Non-secret registry identity for the isolated staging Supabase project.
environmentVariables.sourceBoundary: Explicit environment-scoped metadata; never populated with a credential.
environmentVariables.rotation: Change only when the staging Supabase project is separately reauthorized and rebound.

environmentVariables.name: PRODUCTION_SUPABASE_PROJECT_REF
environmentVariables.purpose: Non-secret comparison identity used to prohibit non-production deployments from silently using Production data.
environmentVariables.sourceBoundary: Explicit environment-scoped metadata; never populated with a credential.
environmentVariables.rotation: Change only when the Production Supabase project is separately reauthorized and rebound.

environmentVariables.name: NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL
environmentVariables.purpose: Public Supabase API endpoint used by browser and server session clients.
environmentVariables.sourceBoundary: Local CLI output or environment-scoped hosted Supabase project metadata.
environmentVariables.rotation: Rebind and redeploy when the project endpoint changes.

environmentVariables.name: NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY
environmentVariables.purpose: Browser-safe publishable Supabase API key; never a secret or service-role key.
environmentVariables.sourceBoundary: Local CLI output or environment-scoped hosted Supabase publishable-key metadata.
environmentVariables.rotation: Rotate under Supabase key policy and redeploy every bound application target.

environmentVariables.name: APP_ORIGIN
environmentVariables.purpose: Canonical absolute application origin for trusted Auth callbacks and same-origin checks.
environmentVariables.sourceBoundary: Environment-scoped canonical origin; never derived from request Host or caller input.
environmentVariables.rotation: Update only with reviewed origin/Auth allow-list binding; redeploy required.

environmentVariables.name: AUTH_REAUTH_PROOF_SECRET
environmentVariables.purpose: Signs exact-user/session recent-password proofs for E3.
environmentVariables.sourceBoundary: Generated and stored only in the approved environment-scoped secret manager; synthetic local values only in tests.
environmentVariables.rotation: Required on suspected disclosure, access-policy change, and the approved recurring secret schedule; rotation invalidates outstanding proofs.

environmentVariables.name: ACCOUNT_CLOSURE_CAPABILITY_SECRET
environmentVariables.purpose: Signs one-minute E5 account-closure capabilities verified by the matching database secret.
environmentVariables.sourceBoundary: Generated and stored only in the approved environment-scoped secret manager; synthetic local values only in tests.
environmentVariables.rotation: Rotate jointly with the matching Vault secret on disclosure, access-policy change, and the approved recurring schedule.

environmentVariables.name: VERCEL_ENV
environmentVariables.purpose: Provider default-environment assertion used only as a contradiction check, never as sole security classification.

environmentVariables.name: VERCEL_TARGET_ENV
environmentVariables.purpose: Provider target assertion, including the staging custom environment, checked against APP_ENVIRONMENT.
environmentVariables.rotation: Provider-managed; target binding changes require review.

environmentVariables.name: VERCEL_GIT_COMMIT_SHA
environmentVariables.purpose: Binds the build to an exact 40-character Git candidate for provenance evidence.
environmentVariables.sourceBoundary: Vercel system environment variable with system-variable exposure enabled.

environmentVariables.name: NODE_ENV
environmentVariables.purpose: Framework mode only; explicitly not an application security-environment identity.

environmentVariables.name: CI
environmentVariables.purpose: Selects deterministic CI behavior such as Playwright retries and server reuse.
environmentVariables.sourceBoundary: GitHub Actions or equivalent CI process.

environmentVariables.name: DATE_E2E_LOCAL_SUPABASE
environmentVariables.purpose: Enables loopback-only authenticated integration fixtures and local failure injection.

environmentVariables.name: LOCAL_SUPABASE_URL
environmentVariables.purpose: Loopback Supabase API endpoint for authenticated local tests.
environmentVariables.sourceBoundary: Parsed from local Supabase CLI status output.

environmentVariables.name: LOCAL_SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY
environmentVariables.purpose: Synthetic/local publishable key used by test clients.
environmentVariables.sourceBoundary: Parsed from local Supabase CLI status output.
environmentVariables.browserExposure: permitted only to the loopback test application

environmentVariables.name: LOCAL_SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY
environmentVariables.purpose: Local administrative fixture setup; stripped before the application process starts.
environmentVariables.sourceBoundary: Parsed from local Supabase CLI status output; never a hosted credential.

environmentVariables.name: LOCAL_SUPABASE_MAILPIT_URL
environmentVariables.purpose: Loopback mail-capture endpoint for local Auth tests.
environmentVariables.sourceBoundary: Parsed from local Supabase CLI status output.

environmentVariables.name: LOCAL_SUPABASE_FAULT_CONTROL_URL
environmentVariables.purpose: Loopback-only Auth/account fault-injection control endpoint.

environmentVariables.name: LOCAL_RELIABILITY_FAULT_CONTROL_URL
environmentVariables.purpose: Loopback-only reliability fault-injection control endpoint.

environmentVariables.name: PLAYWRIGHT_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.purpose: Optional loopback application origin override for browser tests.

environmentVariables.name: PLAYWRIGHT_PORT
environmentVariables.purpose: Optional loopback application port override.

environmentVariables.name: PLAYWRIGHT_HTML_OUTPUT_DIR
environmentVariables.purpose: Phase 11D HTML evidence output location.

environmentVariables.name: PLAYWRIGHT_JSON_OUTPUT_FILE
environmentVariables.purpose: Phase 11D JSON evidence output path.

environmentVariables.name: NODE_OPTIONS
environmentVariables.purpose: Carries the local sign-out fault preload into the test application process.
environmentVariables.sourceBoundary: Repository local-test runner; inherited options are preserved.

environmentVariables.name: HOSTED_ROLE_SUPABASE_WORKDIR
environmentVariables.purpose: Optional disposable local compatibility workdir override; despite its historical name it authorizes no hosted access.

environmentVariables.name: DATABASE_URL
environmentVariables.purpose: Optional local-only database URL checked by ingestion safety guards.
environmentVariables.sourceBoundary: Operator shell; non-loopback values are rejected by the applicable tooling.

environmentVariables.name: SUPABASE_DB_URL
environmentVariables.purpose: Optional local-only database URL checked by ingestion safety guards.
environmentVariables.sourceBoundary: Operator shell; non-loopback values are rejected by the applicable tooling.

environmentVariables.name: SUPABASE_URL
environmentVariables.purpose: Optional local-only Supabase URL checked by ingestion safety guards.
environmentVariables.sourceBoundary: Operator shell; non-loopback values are rejected by the applicable tooling.

environmentVariables.name: PHASE11G2_FIXTURE_PASSWORD
environmentVariables.purpose: Synthetic local qualification password; real identity credentials are prohibited.
environmentVariables.browserExposure: forbidden outside the loopback test process

environmentVariables.name: PHASE11G2_CONCURRENCY_FILTER
environmentVariables.purpose: Optional bounded local qualification group selector.

environmentVariables.name: PHASE11G2_OPERATION_FILTER
environmentVariables.purpose: Optional bounded local qualification operation selector.

environmentVariables.name: PHASE11G2_WARM_SAMPLES
environmentVariables.purpose: Optional local diagnostic warm-sample override.

environmentVariables.name: PHASE11G2_EVIDENCE_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY
environmentVariables.purpose: Run-specific local evidence output directory.

environmentVariables.name: PHASE11G2_EXPECTED_GROUP_COUNT
environmentVariables.purpose: Optional expected group-count assertion for retained G2 evidence.

environmentVariables.name: PHASE11G2_EXPECTED_OPERATION_COUNT
environmentVariables.purpose: Optional expected operation-count assertion for retained G2 evidence.

environmentVariables.name: PHASE11G2_EXPECTED_SAMPLE_COUNT
environmentVariables.purpose: Optional expected sample-count assertion for retained G2 evidence.

environmentVariables.name: PHASE11G2_EXPECTED_WARM_SAMPLES
environmentVariables.purpose: Optional expected warm-sample assertion for retained G2 evidence.

environmentVariables.name: TZ
environmentVariables.purpose: Test-only timezone override for calendar-date behavior.
environmentVariables.sourceBoundary: Individual unit test with restoration after use.

databaseSecrets.name: account_closure_capability_v1
databaseSecrets.purpose: Verifies E5 account-closure capabilities inside PostgreSQL.
databaseSecrets.sourceBoundary: Supabase Vault for the exact bound project; synthetic local provisioning in tests only.

invitationRegister.atomicity: No atomic transaction across the register, Supabase Auth, and application lifecycle state is claimed.
